Avatar: Fire and Ash continues James Cameron's Avatar franchise with diminishing returns. It doesn't push the story or technology nearly as much as its predecessor, and in many ways seems more like Avatar 2.5. So today, let's dive into what went wrong. When and how a franchise starts to lose steam and die off.
